title: Woman in Polluted Waters
description: A woman with white hair and tattoos is submerged to her waist in murky, polluted water, holding a black paddle. She looks toward a decaying wooden pier covered in graffiti and surrounded by floating papers, plastic waste, and pink glowing symbols in the water.
prompt: A woman with white hair in a bun and glowing tattoos stands waist-deep in toxic murky brown water, holding a black paddle, turning her head to look at a decaying wooden pier covered in pink graffiti that reads 'R.I.P. EARTH', floating papers and plastic debris surround her as pink glowing magical symbols and ripples appear on the water surface, dramatic dystopian scene with purple and green toxic sky, detailed digital painting
